Checked all 100 substantive bodies for repeated paragraphs and unique-word lexical overlap. No verbatim paragraph of more than 35 words was duplicated. This is a screening check; genuinely shared diagnostic strategies are documented separately.

sharedDiagnosticLogic.explanation: One verified bank-relative rich/lean imbalance strategy for different cylinders. Separately authored explanations emphasize distinct interpretation and enable-condition pitfalls; no invented cylinder-specific failure causes.

Cam lock-pin electrical family; driver command, bank and electrical fault class preserved. Original resistance cells remain incomplete and explicitly flagged.
Coolant bypass actuator performance, low/high feedback and endpoint-learning branches are distinguished.
